decisions.reason: The online customer portal is distant from the firm's display-only core business and lacks a dedicated product page, making it more likely to be dropped.
The award-winning cardboard packaging display solution strongly aligns with the core offering and earned industry recognition, so it should be kept.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the established product range and has its own product page, indicating active support.
The small counter display fits the firm's temporary retail display focus and is actively presented on the website.
The large freestanding information display aligns with the core cardboard display business and has a dedicated product page.
